item.title: Pigeonhole 1.4.0
item.description:
• Pigeonhole now keeps your pinned tabs and puts them in every window: every space, new windows too. If Chrome comes back from a restart without them, Pigeonhole puts them back.
  • Tick “Disable pinned tabs for this space” beside a space’s Pinned section to keep them out of that space.
  • “Pinned tabs” in the page’s sidebar lists them, with a history to bring back one you closed.
  • Close duplicates never closes a pinned tab.
